verdict: Paid channels are dark; Google Business activity is your only active source.
narrative: This period, all lead activity came through your Google Business Profile — paid advertising on Meta and Google ran at zero spend for the full 28 days, leaving your practice without a trackable paid lead source. Your Google Business Profile delivered 102 actions (24 calls, 40 direction requests, 38 website clicks), but that activity is now trending down, with the last two days recording zero actions against a prior average of roughly six per day. Paid advertising is being reactivated to restore lead volume and give your pipeline a reliable, measurable channel again. Separately, your CRM is showing 464 contacts but no logged opportunities or appointments this period — intake mapping is being corrected so that incoming leads are captured properly going forward. Expect cleaner lead tracking and renewed paid activity in the next reporting window.
